appliedRevisions.whyThisReplacementAndNotTheRegistersExam: The register suggested "The file would not open at all". I rejected it: the clip says "the projector wouldn't read my file", so that option would have been a true statement about the clip and a learner could defend it as a cause, breaking the one-defensible-answer requirement for an item whose stem asks for a reason. originalitySpotCheck.interpretation: A shared everyday topic is not a copied item. The searches found pages on the same topics - studying alone versus in groups, lecture recordings, repair cafes, the fluency illusion - and no page containing this draft's wording. That is the expected result for original content on common topics, and it is consistent with contentOriginalityDeclaration.
